notes: Proved (paper): every hole of the toothpick sieve is a lattice rectangle with boundary in L (parity of stages forbids L-corners and dead ends; square completion), and each hole side is a chain of toothpicks of one stage. Open: power-of-2 sides and short side <= 2 (checked to stage 512); mirror and seam lemmas proved, corner decomposition and strip blocks checked numerically for k <= 6; blocked at the third process type (lower-left strip block). Outside Lean: all (paper proofs; side lengths numerical only).

sources.cite: D. Applegate, O. E. Pol, N. J. A. Sloane, The toothpick sequence and other sequences from cellular automata, Congr. Numer. 206 (2010), arXiv:1004.3036, Sect. 4
sources.what: internal regions are rectangles, proof omitted; no side lengths
